# Test Fixtures Notice & Disclaimer

The files in this directory consist of third-party HTML DOM snapshots and API response payloads (from services such as OpenAI ChatGPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Perplexity, DeepSeek, Qwen, Meta AI, Mistral, etc.).

### Purpose

These fixtures are retained solely for non-commercial automated regression testing, parser verification, and platform interoperability under Fair Use / Fair Dealing principles.
